structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities

law.catch_line: Credit for excessive water and sewer charges
law.text: A locality or authority, as such term is defined in § 15.2-5101, may provide a partial credit for excessive water and sewer charges where high water usage is caused by damaged pipes, leaks, accidents, or other intentional or unintentional causes.
